Definition: from G4862 and G2865; to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others:--carry.
BiblicalUsage: Devout men carry Stephen to his burial and make great lamentation over him. The carrying together is a burial party, men who gather to bear the body of a stoned saint to its rest, and their lamentation is the honour the church pays to its martyrs.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that devout men still carry the fallen to their rest, and I hold that lamentation over a martyr is worship, not despair.
